findings.evidence: Conjugation.lean:392-394: `theorem conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_norm … : (L.conjugate g).norm F (L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g x) = L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g (L.norm F x)`.
findings.fix: Rename to `norm_conjugateCoefficientEquiv` (or flip the equation and keep the name); update the two uses at lines 427 and 431 and the module docstring.
findings.issue: `conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_norm` names the right-hand side; the statement's LHS is `(L.conjugate g).norm F (L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g x)`, so by the file's own LHS-first convention (`groundLevelEquiv_conjugateCohomologyIso_zero_apply`, `conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_normQuotientMk`, `groundNorm_groundInclusion` in GroundNorm.lean) a user looking for a rewrite of `norm (conj x)` will not find it.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'conjugateLayer|layerCohomologyConj|layerGroundConj|layerGalConj|conjGalEquiv|conjRepIso|levelConj\b' code/TauCeti` → no matches; Conjugation.lean:54-55 documents the abelianization map as `MulEquiv.abelianizationCongr`.
findings.fix: Rewrite the description to the actual names (and say that `layerGalConj` is deliberately supplied by `MulEquiv.abelianizationCongr (L.conjugateGalEquiv g)` rather than a declaration), or rename the declarations to the roadmap's suggested names.
findings.issue: The PR description names `conjugateLayer`, `layerCohomologyConj`, `layerGroundConj`, `layerGalConj`, `conjGroundEquiv`, `conjGalEquiv`, `levelConj`, `conjRepIso` as the declarations added; none exist. The code provides `NormalLayer.conjugate`, `conjugateCohomologyIso`, `conjugateGroundLevelEquiv`, `conjugateGroundEquiv`, `conjugateGalEquiv`, `Formation.levelConjEquiv`, `conjugateCoefficientEquiv`, and no abelianized-Galois conjugation declaration at all.

summary: Names in the file describe their conclusions and stay in Tau Ceti namespaces, with one lemma named after the wrong side of its equation. The PR description advertises a set of declaration names (roadmap-suggested) that do not exist in the code.
